Agreement.description:
The agent's agreement verdict for one requirement.

`Option<Agreement>` at the call boundary: the verdict is omitted for
a requirement with zero or one contributing claim, where there is no
agreement to record.

oneOf.description: Contributing claims describe the same value.

Contributing claims disagree; the kernel selects a winner by
resolved authority.

ClaimKind.description:
Closed claim-kind enum on Evidence claims.

The per-slice authority override map in `plan.yaml.slices[]` keys
against this same closed set. `example` (runtime capture claim) is
the runtime capture kind emitted by the `captures` source adapter.

oneOf.description: `kind: call` — function or method call site.

DecisionStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a Decision Record.

The slice authors [`Accepted`](DecisionStatus::Accepted) or
[`Rejected`](DecisionStatus::Rejected);
[`Superseded`](DecisionStatus::Superseded) is engine-only, stamped at
merge when a newer record names this one under `supersedes:`.

oneOf.description: The decision was taken and is in force.
The decision was considered and not taken.
Engine-only: superseded by a later record (`superseded-by`).

ModelClaim.description:
One inline claim under [`ModelRequirement::claims`].

The stable `(source, id, kind)` triple traces the claim to its
Evidence (the claim contract). The single-line `value` and
`path` anchor are read from `evidence/<source>.yaml` by the
provenance projection rather than copied here.

id.description: Claim id within that source's Evidence file.

source.description: Source key the claim came from.

ModelRequirement.description:
One `requirements[]` entry.

The agent authors the behavioral prose (`title`, `statement`,
`scenarios`, `notes`, `domain`), the `agreement` verdict, and the
contributing `claims`; the kernel-owned fields (`id`, `status`,
`sources`, claim `winner`) are optional because the agent omits them
and the kernel re-derives them on projection. The `resolution` label
is not stored here — the provenance projection recomputes it.

agreement.description:
Agent-authored agreement verdict over the contributing claims.
Present only when more than one claim contributes.

baseline-id.description:
Agent-authored baseline `REQ` id when modifying an existing
requirement in a domain that already has a merged baseline.
The kernel takes the projected id from here; omitted for additive
requirements in modified domains.

claims.description:
Agent-authored contributing claims with kernel-projected
`winner` markers. The claim `value` / `path` payload is read
from on-disk Evidence by the provenance projection, not persisted
here.

sources.description: Kernel-projected rendered source list (highest authority first).

ModelTask.description:
One `tasks[]` entry. Ids follow the
`TASK-NNN` / `REQ-NNN` grammars; grammar validation lives in the
drift validators, so these are plain strings here.

depends-on.description: `TASK-NNN` ids that must complete before this task.

RequirementStatus.description: Closed enum for the `Status:` line (workflow §Authority hierarchy).

oneOf.description: One source, or multiple sources that agree.
Tied top-authority disagreement; operator must reconcile.

SliceModel.description:
In-memory view of `model.yaml`, holding the header, the requirement
set with inline provenance, and the task list.

The model carries only the earned core today — `requirements[]` and
`tasks[]`; the deferred non-requirements sections (`domain`, `apis`,
…) are not modeled yet and are ignored on deserialise. `target` is
not persisted — it is resolved on demand from the bound `project`.

requirements.description: The requirement set with inline provenance.

slice.description: Slice name. Kernel-stamped on the persisted file.

version.description:
Stored schema version. Kernel-stamped on the persisted file;
optional because the agent response omits it.

SynthesisArtifacts.description:
The prose-only Markdown artifacts under a [`SynthesisResponse`].

Each is authored by the agent; the render step later injects
provenance lines into the spec bodies.

decisions.description:
Optional slice-authored Decision Records, rendered by the
persist tail to `decisions/<slug>.md` with exact-set
replacement. Empty means the slice sets no durable decision.

SynthesisDecision.description:
One slice-authored Decision Record under
[`SynthesisArtifacts::decisions`].

Carries only the agent-authored fields plus the Nygard prose; the
engine stamps `id` / `slice` / `date` (and any `superseded-by`) at
merge.

related.description: Optional traceability into this slice's requirements (`REQ-NNN`).

slug.description: Stable kebab-case slug — the baseline filename derives from it.

status.description:
`accepted` or `rejected` (`superseded` is engine-only and
refused by the answer schema).

supersedes.description:
Records this decision supersedes — baseline `DEC-NNNN` ids or
sibling slugs from this same slice.

topics.description: Optional kebab-case topic slugs the decision governs.

SynthesisKind.description:
Synthesis response envelope kind.

Serialises to the literal `"response"`. Mirrors
`project::plan::propose`'s
`ProposalKind`, but synthesis has only the response kind — there is
no request wire.

description: Generated judgment-answer schema — generated from the Rust wire types by slice::answers; do not edit. Validates the schema-gated answer to the slice synthesis judgment: the `kind: response` envelope carrying the structured model and the prose-only Markdown artifacts. The deterministic tail re-parses the answer and runs the projection kernel.

artifacts.description:
Prose-only Markdown artifacts (no `ID:` / `Sources:` / `Status:`
lines — the render step injects those).

model.description:
The agent's structured model — the kernel-owned and header
fields are optional in [`SliceModel`], so the agent's
kernel-omitted model deserialises cleanly.

title: Specify synthesis answer
